div.style: color: rgb(58, 38, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 640px; text-align: center; width: 640px;

span.p:
Every agent is a RoutedGemini: its requests go through the free-tier router.
Offline, a replay model answers from reviewed sample data, through the same graphs.
If a model fails mid-check, the same code steps run as a plain state machine, and the trace says so.
